units.title: SG-8.1 Rebuild the contribution sheet on the Radix dialog
Act: Add the shadcn-style Dialog wrapper
Act: Rebuild ContributionSheet on the Dialog parts
Act: Return focus to the trigger when the sheet closes

tests.id: dialogUi.test.tsx::Dialog wrapper > renders an open dialog element with the dialog role
tests.name: renders an open dialog element with the dialog role
tests.title: Dialog wrapper renders an open dialog element with the dialog role
tests.scenario: Given an open Dialog with content, when it is rendered, then a single element with the dialog role is present.

tests.id: dialogUi.test.tsx::Dialog wrapper > exposes the title as accessible name and the description as accessible description
tests.name: exposes the title as accessible name and the description as accessible description
tests.title: Dialog wrapper exposes the title as accessible name and the description as accessible description
tests.scenario: Given an open Dialog whose title is "T" and description is "D", when the dialog is queried by role, then its accessible name is "T" and its accessible description is "D".

tests.id: dialogUi.test.tsx::Dialog wrapper > applies the caller className to the dialog element
tests.name: applies the caller className to the dialog element
tests.title: Dialog wrapper applies the caller className to the dialog element
tests.scenario: Given an open Dialog whose content passes className "x-test", when the dialog is queried by role, then the dialog element carries the "x-test" class.

units.title: Verify: ContributionSheet dialog behavior unit tests

tests.name: Given an open dialog, when Escape is pressed, then onClose is called once
tests.title: ContributionSheet dialog: Escape key closes the dialog once
tests.scenario: Given an open dialog, when Escape is pressed, then onClose is called once

tests.name: Given an open dialog, then it is named by its title and described by the closing note
tests.title: ContributionSheet dialog: has accessible name and closing-note description
tests.scenario: Given an open dialog, then the name is 'Suggest What Happens Next' and the description contains 'Ideas are considered when the Round closes.'

tests.name: Given open is false, then no dialog is rendered
tests.title: ContributionSheet dialog: renders no dialog when closed
tests.scenario: Given open={false}, then queryByRole('dialog') is null

tests.name: Given an open dialog, when the Close button is clicked, then onClose is called
tests.title: ContributionSheet dialog: Close button calls onClose
tests.scenario: Given an open dialog, when the Close button is clicked, then onClose is called

tests.name: Given an open dialog, when an idea is typed and sent, then it still posts and lists the suggestion
tests.title: ContributionSheet dialog: typed idea still posts and lists as Sent
tests.scenario: Given an open dialog, when an idea is typed and Send is clicked, then POST /api/v1/contributions carries world_id and prompt and the suggestion is listed as Sent

tests.name: Given an open sheet, when a prompt is sent, then it posts world_id and prompt and lists the suggestion
tests.title: ContributionSheet: posts a prompt and lists it as Sent
tests.scenario: Given an open sheet, when a prompt is sent, then it posts world_id and prompt and lists the suggestion

tests.name: Given the server answers 429, when a prompt is sent, then it shows the slow-down error
tests.title: ContributionSheet: shows slow-down error on 429
tests.scenario: Given the server answers 429, when a prompt is sent, then it shows the slow-down error

tests.name: Given an open sheet, then it shows the remaining count and the closing note
tests.title: ContributionSheet: shows remaining count and closing note
tests.scenario: Given an open sheet, then it shows the remaining count and the closing note

tests.name: Given the server answers 401 once, when a prompt is sent, then it creates a session and retries in order
tests.title: ContributionSheet: creates a session and retries after 401
tests.scenario: Given the server answers 401 once, when a prompt is sent, then it creates a session and retries in order

tests.name: Given a prompt, when submitContribution runs, then it POSTs world_id and prompt with the session cookie
tests.title: Contribution client: submitContribution POSTs with session cookie
tests.scenario: Given a prompt, when submitContribution runs, then it POSTs world_id and prompt with credentials included

tests.name: Given a round id, when listMine runs, then it GETs the caller contributions for that round
tests.title: Contribution client: listMine GETs the caller's contributions for a round
tests.scenario: Given a round id, when listMine runs, then it GETs /api/v1/player/me/contributions for that round

units.title: Verify: Focus returns to the trigger unit tests

tests.id: appContributionFocus.test.tsx > App contribution focus > Escape returns focus
tests.name: tests/appContributionFocus.test.tsx: Test A
tests.title: Focus returns to the Suggest trigger after Escape
tests.scenario: Given the contribution sheet is open, when the player presses Escape, then focus returns to the Suggest trigger
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appContributionFocus.test.tsx --testTimeout=20000

tests.id: appContributionFocus.test.tsx > App contribution focus > Close returns focus
tests.name: tests/appContributionFocus.test.tsx: Test B
tests.title: Focus returns to the Suggest trigger after Close
tests.scenario: Given the contribution sheet is open, when the player clicks Close, then focus returns to the Suggest trigger
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appContributionFocus.test.tsx --testTimeout=20000

units.title: REQ · A shadcn-style Dialog wrapper exposes Radix dialog parts

REQ · Closing the sheet returns focus to the Suggest What Happens Next trigger
